bio.text: Drew Wrigley is North Dakota's attorney general; he was appointed on an interim basis in 2022, was elected that year, and said in February 2026 that he would run for reelection.

He was born in Bismarck, grew up in Fargo, graduated from the University of North Dakota with honors in economics and philosophy, and received a law degree from American University's Washington College of Law.
He was an assistant district attorney in Philadelphia, U.S. Attorney for North Dakota from 2001 to 2009 and again after a 2019 nomination, and lieutenant governor from December 2010 to December 2016.

sources.title: North Dakota Attorney General Drew Wrigley will run for reelection
